title: Intraday Share Price Volatility and Leveraged ETF Rebalancing
one_line: Leveraged-ETF rebalancing raises end-of-day volatility in S&P 500 stocks, mainly in volatile periods such as 2008 (Review of Finance 20(6)); the effect is small in calm markets.

findings.statement: Late-day volatility rises with implied LETF rebalancing demand, concentrated in high-volatility regimes.

reported_results.headline: Leveraged-ETF rebalancing raises end-of-day volatility in S&P 500 stocks, mainly in volatile periods such as 2008 (Review of Finance 20(6)); the effect is small in calm markets.

tradable_edge: Supports conditioning the LETF close specs on the volatility regime (AvgRange tercile).
